title: Draft game playtest report
description: Proposed report structure for task review. Structural validity does not establish evidence integrity or semantic correctness. This is not a frozen evaluation contract.

case_id.description: Opaque case identifier from the task manifest.

evidence_ids.description: References to observations owned by the browser recorder. Their existence and meaning require independent validation.

claims.description: A complete report must cover every task requirement exactly once. That constraint requires the task manifest and is not enforced by this schema alone.
